messages:
elaine: Heads up — ran the quantization sweep for the new q8 build and noticed the eval CI uploaded unredacted prompt samples to our artifacts bucket. Found several customer-like prompts in s3. @naomi can you triage? dev-bot log below.

dev-bot: artifact-upload success: s3://redwood-evals/temp/1790001234/samples.tar.gz (public-read: false). metadata: uploader=ci-runner-8, job=eval-quant-sweep

vlad: Yikes. Looks like the PR pipeline had SAMPLE_UPLOAD=true enabled. That flag triggers sampling before the redaction step. Quick repro: run `./scripts/run_eval --sample --upload` locally to see same behavior.

sam: Minimal CI snippet from the failing job:```
# .github/workflows/eval.yml
- name: run evals
  env:
    SAMPLE_UPLOAD: true  # <-- accidental override in PR template
  run: ./ci/run_eval.sh
```

naomi: I'm on it. First steps: revoke any temp creds used by the runner, disable the upload job in CI, and rotate the service token that the uploader uses. If any PHI/PII are present we'll need to escalate to legal. elaine, can you list the exact S3 paths and which files look unredacted?

elaine: Paths: s3://redwood-evals/temp/1790001234/samples.tar.gz. Inside archive: prompts.jsonl (raw prompts), model_out.jsonl (outputs), metadata.csv. Sample lines from prompts.jsonl show full user messages (some look like emails/identifiers).

vlad: Proposed fix: move redaction step to happen before any sampling/upload stage. Add a --redact-first flag and make it default true in CI. Also add an uploader check that rejects filenames like `*prompts*`/`*raw*` unless a special admin override exists. Quick pseudo-fix:```
# in runner/upload.py
if filename_matches_raw(name) and not env.get('ALLOW_RAW_UPLOAD'):
    raise RuntimeError('raw artifacts not allowed')
```

dev-bot: Created ticket ML-4872: "eval CI uploaded unredacted samples" and paused the pipeline for branch refs that flipped SAMPLE_UPLOAD.

elaine: I'll open a PR to: 1) default SAMPLE_UPLOAD=false, 2) run redaction as the first transform, 3) add a CI lint that fails if SAMPLE_UPLOAD=true on non-admin branches. Will also scrub and purge the S3 prefix after creds are rotated. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll apply an S3 lifecycle rule to auto-delete the `temp/` prefix after 24h and add a bucket policy requiring kms:Encrypt and a deny on objects with public ACL. Also adding a lambda to validate object keys on PutObject.

naomi: Also a reminder: instrument the eval reporting pipeline so dashboards/exports never include raw prompt text. Add a requirement that exports redact or hash prompt text before being persisted to analytics stores. We'll need an audit entry for every artifact upload (who, why, sha256-of-original, redaction-status).

elaine: Plan recap: short-term = revoke creds + purge artifacts + pause pipelines + update ML-4872. Medium-term = code fix + CI lint + infra bucket policy + lifecycle + dashboard/export changes + audit logs. I'll post PR and link ML-4872. Thanks all.
